name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=portrait/resource, descriptor=load_portrait_to_cache). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately reflects behavior: loads a portrait's 12 sprite frames from FDICON.B24 into the global 200KB sprite cache, idempotent (returns existing cache index on a hit).
purpose: Load one portrait's 12-sprite frame set from FDICON.B24 into the global 200KB sprite cache, returning the portrait's cache slot index (idempotent: a cache hit short-circuits with no disk I/O).
logic_summary: fseek(fp,6) past FDICON.B24 magic; malloc(0x1A40) and fread the sprite-header table; extract 13 int32 abs-offsets for this portrait (12 frame offsets + 1 trailing end-mark) at hdr+(portrait_id*12+i)*4; data_size = offsets[12]-offsets[0]; free header. If cache empty (count==0): first-time init -- record id_list[0], malloc(0x32A00) cache buffer, fseek to offsets[0], fread data into cache+0x780, fill 12 frame-offset table entries as (offsets[i]-offsets[0])+0x780, set buffer_used=data_size+0x780, idx=0. Else: scan id_list[0..count-1]; on match return that index (no I/O); on miss append at tail -- id_list[count]=portrait_id, fseek offsets[0], fread into cache+buffer_used, fill frame-offset table at slot count, buffer_used+=data_size, idx=count. Finally count++, return idx.

params.name: portrait_id
params.semantics: Portrait/character ID (domain 00h-41h) used to index the FDICON.B24 sprite-header table (portrait_id*12 frame offsets) and as the cache id_list key. Callers pass dst->portrait_id (rsrc.c:393) and char_id/bChar_id (fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle).
params.reason: Accurate domain-ID name (portrait IDs are a meaningful FD2 ID space, must be preserved); no address residue.

params.name: fp
params.semantics: Open FILE* handle to FDICON.B24 (cast to void*), consumed by fseek/fread for the header table and the per-portrait sprite payload reads.
params.reason: Standard, clear file-pointer name matching its use; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Cache slot index of the loaded (or already-cached) portrait. Callers store it into runtime_char sprite_state[0] as the per-unit portrait reference.
